第67章 虹桥置业，故人的回响-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

张虎目送林川车的尾灯消失在黄浦路尽头，回过头，脸上那排白牙还没收回去。

宋清站在他旁边，两只手攥着他的胳膊，用力晃了一下。

“你那个朋友……”

“兄弟。”张虎纠正。

宋清没理他。“他说的那些，张江、供应链、三到五个亿——是真的？”

“你看我是像是能编出这种话的人吗？”

宋清没接。她想了想，声音轻了。“我爸刚才在跟我妈说了句话。”

“啥？”

“他说，希望你以后能好好对他们的女儿。”

宋清嘴角一扬。

张虎愣了两秒。喉结滚了一下。

他仰头看了看黄浦江方向的天际线，深吸一口气，把那口憋了很久的浊气吐了个干净。

周日上午。

顾城的电话九点准时打进来。

“川子，房子我筛了四套，都在西郊。你能去看不？”

“可以，半小时后。”

林川换了件简单的灰色套头衫，开车去接顾城。

第一套在佘山脚下。

独栋，八百平，带私家花园。

白墙灰瓦，围墙圈了将近两亩地。

前庭有喷泉水池，后院种了一排银杏。

车道能同时停四辆车。

顾城叼着一根没点的烟走在前面，拿手往花园方向一指。

“这套开发商自留的，没上过市面。原价两千二，我帮你谈到一千九。精装，拎包入住。”

林川没急着进屋，先绕着房子走了一圈。

他看的不是装修。

客房有几间——小冉放假回来，沈蔓过来，不能挤。

花园的日照好不好——他妈在老家就爱种菜，这边要是没块能晒到太阳的地方，她待不住。

“后院朝向不行。”林川走回来，摇了下头。“下午两点以后全是阴的。”

顾城眨了下眼。“你爸是要在后院晒太阳？”

“我妈要种菜。”

顾城噎了一秒，把没点的烟从嘴里拿下来。

“……行，下一套。”

第二套在青浦。面积更大，一千二百平，带泳池和地下影音室。

但位置太偏，离市区四十分钟车程。

Zhang Hu watched the taillights of Lin Chuan's car disappear at the end of Huangpu Road. When he turned around, the row of white teeth on his face had not yet been retracted.

Song Qing stood next to him, holding his arm with both hands and shaking it hard.

"That friend of yours..."

"Brother." Zhang Hu corrected.

Song Qing ignored him.“What he said about Zhangjiang, the supply chain, three to five hundred million—is it true?”

"Do you think I am someone who can make up such a thing?"

Song Qing didn't answer.She thought for a moment and softened her voice."My dad was talking to my mom just now."

"What?"

"He said, I hope you can treat their daughter well in the future."

Song Qing raised the corner of his mouth.

Zhang Hu was stunned for two seconds.The Adam's apple rolled.

He looked up at the skyline in the direction of the Huangpu River, took a deep breath, and exhaled the turbid air that he had been holding in for a long time.

Sunday morning.

Gu Cheng's call came in at nine o'clock on time.

"Kawako, I have screened four houses, all in the western suburbs. Can you take a look?"

"Okay, in half an hour."

Lin Chuan changed into a simple gray pullover and drove to pick up Gu Cheng.

The first set is at the foot of Sheshan Mountain.

Single-family house, 800 square meters, with private garden.

It has white walls and gray tiles, and the wall surrounds nearly two acres of land.

There is a fountain in the front yard and a row of ginkgo trees in the backyard.

The driveway can park four cars at the same time.

Gu Cheng walked in front with an unlit cigarette in his mouth and pointed in the direction of the garden.

"This set is reserved by the developer and has never been put on the market. The original price is two thousand two thousand, but I can help you negotiate for one thousand ninety-nine. It is well-decorated and ready to move in."

Lin Chuan was not in a hurry to enter the house and walked around the house first.

What he was looking at was not decoration.

There are several guest rooms - Xiaoran comes back from vacation and Shen Man comes over, so they can't be crowded.

Is the garden getting good sunlight? Her mother loved growing vegetables in her hometown. If there wasn’t a place to get the sun, she wouldn’t be able to stay here.

"The direction of the backyard doesn't work." Lin Chuan walked back and shook his head."It will be cloudy after 2 p.m."

Gu Cheng blinked."Is your dad going to bask in the sunshine in the backyard?"

"My mother wants to grow vegetables."

Gu Cheng choked for a second and took the unlit cigarette out of his mouth.

"...Okay, next set."

The second set is in Qingpu.The area is larger, 1,200 square meters, with a swimming pool and underground video room.

But the location is too remote, a 40-minute drive from the city.
